description: This PHP source file defines the VTWorkflowEventHandler class, which handles workflow-related events within the vtiger CRM system. It manages the execution of workflows based on different trigger conditions, evaluates workflows, and performs associated tasks when conditions are met.

classes.name: VTWorkflowEventHandler
classes.description: Handles workflow events such as first save, modification, manual trigger, or every save within vtiger CRM. Manages workflow evaluation and execution based on configured conditions.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Main method invoked to handle workflow events. Determines whether to evaluate workflows based on event type and conditions, and executes workflow tasks if applicable.
